name: truemarkets-mcp-server
description: Enables AI agents to perform native trading on True Markets by providing tools for price lookups, balance management, and secure trade execution with quote caching. It replaces fragile CLI-based workflows with structured JSON responses and persistent authentication for more reliable financial operations.
